name: Cerberus Will

abilities.name: Threshold Guard
abilities.effect: Planted stance: the tamer shrugs off knockback and some damage for a short time, a faint triple-ring glow at the feet.

abilities.name: Hound Lunge
abilities.effect: A short sudden hound lunge forward with red afterimages.

acquire.equipPiece: One spiked hound-collar bracer on one forearm; three faint claw-scar glows on it while guarding.

abilities.name: Triple Howl
abilities.effect: All three heads howl: nearby foes are rattled, slowed and flinch (the gate-guard's fear); allies nearby gain nerve.

abilities.name: Hellfire Breath
abilities.effect: The three heads breathe hellfire in a cone of black-red flame that burns and blinds.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form three-headed hound-beastman: a central hound head with glowing red eyes plus two extra hound heads on the shoulders, ember-edged fur mantle over studded plate, flame-clawed hands, digitigrade iron-greaved hound legs, an ember-tipped tail and a spiked collar ridge.

equip.weapon: Hellfire claw-blades grown over both clawed hands (the three-headed chain-spike is the Mastery seal).
equip.armor: Black gatekeeper plate: a spiked collar ridge, studded pauldrons, iron-banded greaves and a fur mantle edged with embers.
equip.hair_eyes: Black ember-edged fur mane; three pairs of glowing red hound eyes (centre and two shoulder heads).
equip.aura: Red hellfire aura with low flame licking at the feet.

lore: A giant mana hound with three snarling heads whose will keeps a threshold: nothing it guards gets out and nothing unwelcome gets in.
pitch: Cerberus is the three-headed hound of Hades who lets nothing out of the gate and nothing unwelcome in. Acquire keeps you human, planting your feet like a gate and lunging, with one equipped piece, a single spiked hound-collar bracer, for a short guard stance and a hound lunge. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a black-furred three-headed hound-beastman in ember-edged gate armour with hellfire claws; it is the heaviest stat bruiser of the S ranks at a high price.
untrained: An untrained holder hears three voices and cannot tell which is their own: strain spikes in bursts, vision doubles, and hellfire scorches them from inside. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A massive three-headed hound-beastman in black gate armour: a central snarling hound head and two extra heads rising from the shoulders, ember-edged black fur mantle, spiked collar ridge, clawed hands with flame claws, digitigrade hound legs, ember-tipped tail.
spirit.look: A blood-red orb with three small glowing ember eyes in a triangle and a ring of low flame licking around it.
